label: Pharmacy
tagline: Keep a dispensary stocked, safe and in date
opening: You've just joined the dispensary team at **<<biz>>**. Running out of a medicine is a real problem for real people, so the pharmacist wants a program that tracks every shelf.
rule: The pharmacist's rule: when a medicine is down to **<<level>> packs or fewer**, it must be reordered straight away.
scene: A nurse phones: "Have you got <<n2>>?" The pharmacist can't stop dispensing to scroll a report. The ledger needs a quick lookup, and it must cope with medicines you don't hold.

action.name: dispense
action.doc: hand out packs and return how many are left

glossary: To hand a medicine to a patient. Your stock goes down when you do it.
The unit a medicine is sold in, such as a box of tablets or a bottle.
The company that supplies the pharmacy in bulk.
The fewest packs you are allowed to hold before reordering.
The date after which a medicine must not be given. Expired stock is removed.
A medicine with legal rules on storage and records. Mistakes are serious.
The record of what comes in and goes out. This program replaces it.
py_uses: Check that cold-chain fridges stayed in range overnight
Flag medicines close to expiry before they are wasted
Reconcile dispensed packs against the stock ledger
